label: Load data
description: Reads the set's file (.mff folder, .set, .edf, .eeg/.vhdr, .nxe) and saves <sessionID>_raw.set. Starts a new processing log, so running it again starts the set over.

label: Channel setup
description: Channel locations, peripheral (ExG) channel types and split. Saves <sessionID>_chanSetup.set.

label: Edit event markers (video)
description: Opens the video editor to check and edit event markers. Saves <sessionID>_videoEdited.

label: Segmentation (keep / cut by events)
description: Rule builder for keeping or cutting stretches of the recording by event times. Continuous data only. Saves <sessionID>_segmented.set (or one file per segment).

label: Downsample
description: Resamples to cfg.recording.target_fs (asks to confirm). Saves <sessionID>_resampled.set.

label: Filter
description: High-pass / low-pass / notch from cfg.filter (asks to confirm). Saves <sessionID>_filtered.set.

label: Bad channel detection
description: Flags bad channels (variance, kurtosis, neighbour correlation, bridging, flat) with a review window. Shared settings cover the detection methods and the histogram question; the review stays per file. Saves <sessionID>_badChanFlag.set.

label: Epoching
description: Cuts epochs around chosen events (shared settings keep the events by name). Saves <sessionID>_epoched.set.

label: Baseline correction (epoched)

settings.label: Baseline window (ms, e.g. -200 -2; empty = ask each time)

description: Baseline-corrects epoched data (pop_rmbase) over a window from the settings, or asks for one (asked once per batch with same settings). Saves <sessionID>_baselined.set.

label: Bad segment rejection
description: Marks bad stretches by scrolling the data. Tagged segmentRejection_raw or segmentRejection_component (numbered per round). Once ICA has been run it asks whether to scroll the channel data or the component activations (that answer is what gets shared).

label: Re-reference
description: Average, channel(s), linked mastoids, median or robust average reference (Settings default; asks unless told not to). Reference channel(s) are used for Channel(s) and Linked mastoids; left empty, linked mastoids are guessed from names like TP9/TP10, M1/M2, A1/A2. Tagged by reference, e.g. rerefavg, rerefcz, then rerefavg2. Before ICA it also stores the ICA rank; the first time it asks for the VREF channel. Saved as preICAreref, preICA2reref or finalReRef depending on where it runs.

label: ICA

settings.label: Extra high-pass on the copy ICA learns from (Hz)

description: Runs the set's ICA method (cfg.ica.method: Picard, AMICA, runica (extended Infomax) or FastICA). Rounds are numbered ICA1, ICA2, ...

label: Component removal

settings.label: ICLabel probability to flag a component (0-1)

description: ICLabel classification, review, and removal of artifact components. Shared settings cover the viewer choice; the review stays per file. Saves <sessionID>_componentRemoval1.set (numbered per round).

label: Interpolate bad channels
description: Spherical interpolation of the masked bad channels. Saves <sessionID>_interp.set.

label: Apply cuts

settings.label: Drop kept pieces shorter than (s, empty = off; suggested 2)
settings.help: Continuous data only. After the cuts, any stretch of kept data shorter than this is cut as well, so the analysis-ready set has no slivers. Cuts themselves are never shortened or merged.

description: Removes everything the masks (bad channels, segments, epochs) marked bad. Saves <sessionID>_maskCut.set.

label: Demean

settings.label: Baseline window for epoched data (ms, e.g. -200 0; empty = whole epoch)

description: Removes each channel's mean (continuous: mean of the good samples; epoched: each epoch's mean, or a baseline window from the settings). Saves <sessionID>_demeaned.set.

label: Surface Laplacian (CSD)
description: Spherical-spline surface Laplacian (Perrin 1989, as in the CSD toolbox; m = 4, lambda = 1e-5). Needs channel positions; bad channels are estimated, not used. Clears any ICA. Saves <sessionID>_laplacian.set.

label: Export QC report
description: Writes the QC summary and removal log to QC\<sessionID>_removalLog.mat (overwritten each time, it describes the current state).
